description: Manually calculated six-round lifecycle baseline. Every player places two workshops, then passes each round. This tests income, bonus rotation, science rewards, power, ranking and final conversion; it is not coverage of a strategic full game.
manualArithmetic: All networks have size 1; area tie shares (18+12+6)/3=12 each.
Science awards are 28,8,8. Base score is 20 each.
Final convertible resource totals are 68,58,65, giving 13,11,13 points.
P1 coin total is 15 initial +14 bonus income +5 banking round reward +5 coins from bonus selection.
